purpose: Values for the Phase 1 learning window, 10 to 17 weeks from the last menstrual period (USER 2026-11-14). Separate from global_config.json, which stays the only source of 12.5 week values for every constant it holds. Each value is a set of age points: {"ages": {"<weeks>": {"value": ..., "status": ...}}}. Built into local/db/trusoma_window_10_17.sqlite by companion/source_audit/build_window_db.py. No code reads this file yet.

growth7.crl_window.meaning: crown-rump length past the INTERGROWTH-21st CRL range (above growth7.ga_ig), Hadlock 1992 dating formula inverted; joined to the master crl(ga_ig) at 14 weeks by the reader

body7.arm_rest_window.meaning: arm rest posture (shoulder flexion, abduction, internal rotation, elbow), both arms, from the age's table row by rest_pose_fit.py (12.5 week method); each row holds from its age to the next

brainstem_s2.w_int_window.meaning: head integrator W_INT at ages without a solve: linear between the frozen solves at 15.0 (1.11) and 34.5 weeks (1.145) (other_config registry s2bh_wint_frozen); a re-solve on the current tree replaces it

brainstem_s2.s2b_bias_window.meaning: general-movement generator biases at 14-17 weeks: carried from the 12.5 week fit (not refitted; the 12.5 fit targets de Vries 1985 at 12-13 weeks); a refit against de Vries 1985's 14-17 week counts replaces it
